thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected on inference-prod: p95 latency > 1.8s, queue depth spiking -> possible GPU pool saturation. Paging on-call now: @sarah.

sarah: I'm on it, taking lead. brief status?

alice: seeing huge backlog on /v1/generate, queue_depth ~ 4800, worker_reqs_in_flight at pool-gpu-02 = 96/96. p99 latency > 3s.

brad: confirmed, autoscaler HPA metric shows CPU stable but custom "inference_queue_depth" > scale_threshold. HPA didn't trigger because it reads per-node metrics, not per-pool.

mike: hypothesis: cold starts / warmup delay + all GPUs at capacity for large seq jobs causing head-of-line blocking.

paul: digging logs from runtime:
```
[kernel] pool-gpu-02 saturating: open_streams=96, kv_cache_misses=1200, warmup_latency_ms=450
[autoscaler] desired_replicas=3 current_replicas=3 last_scale_event=+57m
[ingress] backlog_enqueue_time>200ms for 4k reqs
```

julia: customer impact: some L7 errors (429) but mostly high latencies; several customers reported degraded UX. Not full 5xx outage.

sarah: immediate mitigations: 1) divert traffic for heavy-seq models to fallback smaller variant 2) manually scale pool-gpu-02 by +1 node 3) warm up kernels on new node with pinned prompts. Who can run the manual scale?

paul: I can. kicking off scale now. running warmup script after node joins.

infra-bot: Scaling pool-gpu-02 from 3 -> 4 (requested by paul). New node provisioned, joining cluster.

alice: while we wait, applying route override to send model-id:large-seq -> model-id:medium-seq for 10% of traffic, canary policy. code snippet: `curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","transform":"model:large->medium","percent":10}'`

brad: routed 10%, telemetry shows p95 down slightly for that slice. queue depth overall still high but trending down.

mike: warmup script logs:
```
Warming kernels on new node...
preload weights 2/2 done
kv cache populated for common prefixes
warmup_latency_samples: avg=120ms
```

paul: new node ready, adding to pool, manual rebalance started.

sarah: handoff: @sarah -> @brad in 15m (brad will be on-call until 08:00 UTC). Brad you see anything else to run?

brad: taking handoff. next actions: 1) collect timeline & hypothesis in this thread, 2) run HPA metric audit (why it didn't scale), 3) consider lowering warmup GC thresholds so new nodes accept traffic faster.

alice: timeline so far (for RCA):
- T0: incident-bot page (queue depth cross threshold)
- T+2m: p95 latency spike noticed, customers report slow responses
- T+6m: HPA did not scale (no per-pool metric)
- T+10m: manual scale requested
- T+16m: new node joined, warmup started
- T+22m: routing to medium model canary -> latency improves on that slice
- T+30m: pool back to headroom, p95 back to baseline

mike: hypothesis log notes: warmup_latency_ms peaked because kernel compilation and kv cache population were synchronous on first request. we should pre-warm on provision. also HPA blind spot: uses pod CPU, not inference queue.

brad: for the RCA we need: a) graph of queue_depth vs desired_replicas, b) HPA event logs, c) kernel warmup timing per node, d) list of impacted customers + samples. can each owner drop logs here?

paul: dropping autoscaler events (snip):
```
[autoscaler] 10:14 desired=3 reason="no scaleup: metric 'cpu' below threshold"
[autoscaler] 10:20 scaleup cancelled: insufficient quota for instance type
[autoscaler] 10:25 desired=3
```

alice: dropping queue-depth window from metrics: `https://grafana/redwood/d/infer/queue?from=10:00&to=11:00` (link) snapshots attached in pager.

julia: added impacted customer list to shared doc: customers A,C,F with sample request ids.

sarah: recording hypothesis tags inline: [H1: HPA metric mismatch], [H2: warmup delay/cold start], [H3: model-heavy head-of-line blocking]. We will validate in order.

brad: validation plan: H1 -> compare queue_depth vs HPA metric timeline, H2 -> extract warmup latencies from node bootstrap logs, H3 -> correlate high-seq jobs with long tail. assign owners: H1=brad, H2=paul, H3=mike.

mike: quick query for H3: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE seq_len>1024 AND duration>2000s GROUP BY 5m` - will paste results shortly.

paul: I'll pull node bootstrap logs and annotate warmup start/end.

alice: I'll compile the customer impact snippets and notify support to open a PSR (post-incident) with affected accounts.

sarah: thanks team. leaving notes: keep this thread as the single source for timeline & hypothesis. if we confirm a config gap (HPA blind spot) we should file infra/infra-task to add per-pool queue metric to HPA and set a scale target.

brad: note for postmortem: consider autoscaler quota errors shown in logs -> might have prevented scale event earlier. we need retry/backoff and quota-aware fallback.

julia: adding remediation items to shared board: 1) HPA -> queue metric integration, 2) pre-warm step in node provisioning, 3) routing fallback policy for heavy-model traffic.

paul: closing mitigation: pool headroom restored, queue depth stable. marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: mitigated -> monitoring. please follow postmortem checklist: link to template. :white_check_mark:
